name: SecureFix Vulnerable Demo Findings Catalog
description: Authoritative catalog of eight intentional, synthetic security test fixtures for SecureFix AI testing.

findings.title: Broken Object-Level Authorization (IDOR)
findings.description: Task lookup does not enforce synthetic owner scope, allowing callers to access tasks belonging to other synthetic owners.
findings.safe_verification: Simulate a caller with X-User-Id: owner_1 requesting a task owned by owner_2. Verify task is returned without authorization denial.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: SQL Query Concatenation
findings.description: Task search builds a read-only SQL query by concatenating input directly into the query string rather than binding parameters.
findings.safe_verification: Execute search with benign search terms and statically verify that query string concatenation is used instead of parameterized queries.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Unsafe Dynamic Evaluation
findings.description: Report filter helper evaluates a harmless demo expression dynamically using Python eval().
findings.safe_verification: Verify dynamic evaluation of benign boolean expressions against summary metrics and verify presence of eval() construct.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Permissive CORS Configuration
findings.description: CORS configuration uses wildcard origins with permissive methods and headers.
findings.safe_verification: Send an OPTIONS preflight request with Origin header and assert Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header is '*'.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Verbose Error Responses
findings.description: Controlled error response includes synthetic diagnostic fields and internal exception class names.
findings.safe_verification: Trigger controlled test error endpoint and verify presence of synthetic diagnostic field and exception class in response.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Missing Defensive Security Headers
findings.description: Defensive response headers (X-Content-Type-Options, Content-Security-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security) are not configured.
findings.safe_verification: Inspect response headers from API endpoints and assert absence of defensive security headers.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Hardcoded Fake Credential
findings.description: A nonfunctional fake credential-like value is present for scanner testing.
findings.safe_verification: Assert presence of the fake credential string in config and confirm it is completely unused by authentication logic.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.

findings.title: Version Disclosure
findings.description: Demo version metadata is exposed by the application.
findings.safe_verification: Query GET /health and assert response exposes demo application version metadata.
findings.provenance: Hand-authored synthetic fixture for SecureFix AI ingestion and remediation testing.
